answer: The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, reduced by each unverified claim, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the raven of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Work waits on the jade until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the saffron of the next round.
